propositions: Existing deterministic repair, schema extraction, and sentinel selection logic in structured.parse_structured and structured.check_response must be adapted to work through Pydantic AI output functions and capability hooks without cloning or rewriting parser behavior.

A new TextOutput output function in pai_output.py must call parse_structured, catch retryable StructuredOutputError, and raise ModelRetry with the original Rebar error preserved in __cause__ to let Pydantic AI drive bounded output retry.

Provider stop/refusal safety checks from structured.check_response must run via an after_model_request capability hook that receives the full ModelResponse, raises terminal UnretryableOutputError to abort without retry, or raises retryable StructuredOutputError to propagate to the output function.
Recovery cases (repairable JSON, sentinel content, decoy-plus-valid) must produce identical values before and after adapter integration, verified against existing test_structured.py oracle.
Refusal and content-filter responses must terminate after one model call with UnretryableOutputError and emit no Pydantic retry prompt.
